title: signal-scout-synthesis-nov-07-2027
content:
Signal Scout — weekly synthesis (notes for on-call rotation and tracker)
Date: 2027-11-07
Owner: Aisha Kumar (SRE lead)
Purpose: concise digest for the coming week: incident capsules, SLO snapshot, shift-change summary, and prioritized work for follow-ups. Keep this as the single place for quick handover reading.

1) Quick headlines
- Production incidents this week: 2 user-facing degradations, 1 backend throttling alert.
- SLO status: token-gen p99 latency drifted to 650ms (target 450ms) during a burst window on 11/05 — currently within error budget but trending.
- Cache effectiveness: KV prefix hit-rate dropped to 62% in the burst (baseline ~78%). Root cause suspected: model routing imbalance + recent routing policy tweak (route-policy-3).

2) Incident capsules (short)
- Incident: prompting-timeout-degrade (11/05 04:15–04:47 UTC)
  - Symptoms: p99 token-gen latency spike, increased tail errors (context-lost).
  - Impact: ~3200 requests with >1s tail latency; ephemeral client retries. No data exfiltration.
  - Immediate mitigation: disabled route-policy-3 fallback, rolled back to route-policy-2, increased per-worker concurrency for affected pool.
  - Next actions: perf profile trace (SRE-4521), simulate traffic pattern locally to reproduce cache miss wave. Owner: Michael Chen.

- Incident: async-queue-throttle (11/06 12:30–13:05 UTC)
  - Symptoms: internal task queue latency backpressure, cascade of enqueue retries into the ML pre-processor.
  - Impact: delayed batch assembly for dedicated pool, degraded throughput for a small subset of enterprise tenants during peak.
  - Immediate mitigation: temporary scaled-up worker group for preproc, engaged infra autoscaler.
  - Next actions: rewrite retry policy for enqueue (SRE-4523), add saturation alert for queue depth > 80%. Owner: Samira Ortiz.

3) SLO snapshot
- token-gen latency (p99): target 450ms — current rolling 7d: 480ms; trend: +12% week-over-week.
- embed-ingest success rate: target 99.9% — current: 99.94%.
- error budget: token-gen has 1.8% of budget remaining this quarter. Recommendation: prioritize latency mitigations; avoid risky infra changes during peak window.

4) Metrics and signals to watch this week
- KV cache hit-rate (global) — baseline 75–80%: alert on sustained <68% for 30m.
- routing-policy-variant-rate: ensure no single policy >65% of traffic for >10m.
- infra GPU-utilization: watch for per-AZ imbalance (seen 11/05).

5) On-call changeover notes (shift-change summary)
- Incoming on-call: Tomas Rios (primary), backup: Priya Desai.
- Quick wins for incoming: run the repro script for SRE-4521 in staging, check preproc queue metrics, reconcile any silent restarts in pool-3 for last 48h.
- Slack channels: #sre-ops (primary), #hosting-incidents (escalation). Pager rotations: see calendar invite.

6) Action backlog (prioritized)
- High (P0/P1)
  - A: finish perf trace for prompting-timeout-degrade, produce regression checklist (owner: Michael Chen, due 2027-11-10).
  - B: implement queue-depth alert and rewrite enqueue retry policy (owner: Samira Ortiz, due 2027-11-14).
- Medium
  - C: evaluate routing-policy telemetry and add smoothing heuristic to prevent policy-thrashing (owner: Aisha Kumar, due 2027-11-21).
  - D: KV cache instrumentation: add per-tenant hit-rate breakdown to identify hot tenants (owner: Tomás Rios, due 2027-11-18).

7) Open questions / discussion items
- Did the routing tweak on 11/04 expose a latent capacity imbalance, or did it interact with the recent model-quantization rollout? (Need paired experiment)
- Are there tenants that systematically drive prefix churn? If so, can we introduce tenant-scoped caching policies?

8) Runbook and playbook edits (notes)
- Suggest minor edit: when p99 latency >600ms for 15m, run the "rapid-reduce-concurrency" sequence before rolling back routing policies to reduce blast radius. Draft PR: github.com/redwood/inference/ops-runbooks#pr-129.

9) Meeting syncs this week
- Tues 11/09 09:30 UTC: SLO review + mitigation plan (30m) — owners: Aisha, Michael.
- Thurs 11/11 16:00 UTC: Incident RCA kickoff (1h) — attendees: SRE, Serving Runtime, Platform Eng.

10) Notes to self / scratchpad
- Quick checklist for incoming: run kube-describe on pool-3 nodes, check for OOM restarts (cmd: k get pods -l pool=pool-3 -o wide), tail /var/log/modelsrv for context-lost entries.
- Save perf snapshots to /mnt/snapshots/11-05 and attach to SRE-4521.

If you're reading this as the next primary — prioritize the perf trace (it surfaces root signals) and don't change routing policies at the same time as repro attempts (we want a stable baseline).
